The Aindar/Shedgum line appears in OPEC ASB 2012 Table 4.10 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members' (PDF p.78), i.e. classified as a gas pipeline -> Fuel=Gas. Single strong primary source; PDF content confirmed via pypdf (url_verifier PDF false-negative).

OPEC ASB 2012 Table 4.10 gives length 21 miles for Aindar/Shedgum. 21 mi = 33.8 km, rounding to the recorded 34.00 km. Consistent with GEM value. Single strong primary source; content confirmed via pypdf (url_verifier PDF false-negative).
OPEC ASB 2012 Table 4.10 lists diameter 12 inches for Aindar/Shedgum, matching GEM Diameter=12 in. Single strong primary source; content confirmed via pypdf (url_verifier PDF false-negative).

OPEC ASB 2012 Table 4.10 names the line 'Aindar/Shedgum' (origin/destination), so FuelSource=Aindar (the Ain Dar Ghawar production area). Corroborated by Ghawar-field reporting (Ain Dar and Shedgum are adjacent Ghawar production areas). Single strong primary source; content confirmed via pypdf.

OPEC ASB 2012 Table 4.10 lists the line under Saudi Arabia as 'Aindar/Shedgum' -> Start=Aindar (Ain Dar), End=Shedgum, Country=Saudi Arabia. Both Ain Dar and Shedgum are Ghawar production areas in the Eastern Province (Ash Sharqiyah) per Ghawar-field reporting, supporting StartState/Province=Ash Sharqiyah and EndState/Province=Eastern Province (same region, Arabic vs English name). Province not stated in OPEC table (common-knowledge corroboration). Single strong primary source for the endpoints/country.

OPEC ASB 2012 Table 4.10 gives 'Owner or operator = Saudi Aramco' for Aindar/Shedgum, matching Owner1=Saudi Aramco 100%. Consistent with all Saudi entries in the table (national oil company). Single strong primary source; content confirmed via pypdf (url_verifier PDF false-negative).
